resource_and_entry_guard.covered: ForwardLedger debits the REAL 19-D input-vector rows BEFORE any forward and refuses before exceeding the cap; billing unit is the target-level input row (never the joint decision row, never the call count); failures, retries and repeats are all charged; the counter persists across instances so a restart does not zero it; batches are grouped by real input rows with a 1024 cap and an oversized single step is reported rather than silently split; DuplicateOutputGuard refuses an implicit re-run over an existing artefact; LicenseGate requires a VERIFIED RealLicense (a raw string/dict token is rejected at construction, a test-only spy verifier cannot unlock the real provider, and require refuses both an absent and a test-only licence); CalibrationInitializer bills ONLY the real row count at the trunk entry (guarded_trunk_forward: 2-D (N,19) shape, N>0, N<=1024, atomic debit of the real N, then the same matrix delegated exactly once) and never pre-debits from estimated counts
resource_and_entry_guard.hardening: persisted ledger state is validated on load (missing/corrupt/non-int/negative/over-cap/wrong-cap/foreign-identity state raises LedgerStateError and is never silently zeroed); persist is same-dir temp + fsync + os.replace under a lock file that fails closed on a residual lock unless an explicit recorded recovery_basis is supplied (never auto-deleted); debit persists the new state before committing in memory and records refusals without refunding
resource_and_entry_guard.fail_closed: LicenseGate refuses every gated action (real-data fit, model forward, claim write, checkpoint write, episode call, optimizer step, PPO replay, environment build) when no real licence token is present, and the initialiser raises at the FIRST gate so no collaborator runs and no charge occurs
resource_and_entry_guard.not_claimed: the ledger is an in-process guard over a persisted counter; it does NOT claim physical power-loss atomicity, and a spy/no-op is not a real update
resource_and_entry_guard.not_added: no invented conditions such as 'the receipt must live outside the repository' or 'exactly N claim files'
